reports.title: WEBTOON Entertainment Inc. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Fourth Quarter 2026 Outlook
section: For the fourth quarter 2026, the Company expects:
•Revenue growth on a constant currency basis in the range of 9.0%-12.0%. This represents revenue in the range of $371-$381 million, based on current FX rates.
•Adjusted EBITDA in the range of $0.0-$5.0 million, representing an Adjusted EBITDA Margin in the range of 0.0%-1.3%.
Our fourth quarter 2026 outlook includes expected revenue and contributions from RI Games Holdings Inc. following the anticipated second closing of the transaction.

desk.headline: Revenue down 4% to $363m, below estimates; Q4 outlook of $371-381m points to 9-12% constant-currency growth
results: Revenue fell 4% to $363m as a weaker yen hurt; in constant currency it was flat (+0.2%).
Korea grew 10.8% and advertising rose 26%, but Japan fell 18% and IP adaptations dropped 28%.
The net loss narrowed to $7.5m ($0.06 a share) from $11.1m; adjusted EPS was $0.02.
Adjusted EBITDA slipped to $2.2m on foreign-exchange losses; marketing spend rose 11% to $39.1m.
Operating cash flow was $6.2m for the quarter; cash was $548m with no debt.

guidance.summary: For Q4 WEBTOON expects revenue of $371-381m, or 9-12% growth in constant currency, including the planned RI Games deal, and adjusted EBITDA of $0-5m.

points: Management repeated its aim of double-digit revenue growth in Q4 and said the Q4 range reflects full-quarter growth, helped partly by IP deals moving from Q3.
Japan remains the weak spot; the company plans to invest ¥10bn over three years in local Japanese content and named a new Japan business chief.
Advertising was the strongest line, with broader advertisers in Korea and growth in other regions.
AI tools are being used to widen reach: auto-translation lifted non-English reads of CANVAS episodes by almost 40%.
RI Games was described as a small contributor, with Q4 growth mostly organic.
call.source: Shareholder letter (Exhibit 99.2); call coverage: Earnings Whispers via Finviz, 9 Nov 2026

watch: Whether Q4 revenue lands in the $371-381m range and growth returns to double digits.
Signs of a turnaround in Japan revenue and paying users.
Whether advertising growth can keep offsetting weaker IP adaptation revenue.
